# Manifest Advisors

> Manifest Advisors (manifestadviso.rs) is a strategy and growth advisory firm founded by Jennifer (Jen) Tacheff in October 2019. It works with founders, startups, venture funds, global companies, and mission-driven organizations at critical growth moments—launching a fund, scaling a company, or entering a new market.

Key facts:

- Name: Manifest Advisors (also shortened to "Manifest"). Website: https://manifestadviso.rs/. Tagline: "Your next move matters."
- Founded: October 2019, by Jennifer (Jen) Tacheff, Founder & CEO.
- Founder: Jennifer Tacheff, a growth strategist, ecosystem builder, startup mentor, and executive coach. She was named a 2023 Techstars All-Star Mentor, has taught as a visiting lecturer at UC Berkeley's Haas School of Business, and has served on the SXSW Board of Advisors.
- Services: Growth & Go-to-Market, Funds & Fundraising, Brand & Storytelling, Leadership & Coaching, and Innovation & AI.
- Engagements can take the form of strategic advice, coaching, a defined project, or fractional leadership (including fractional CMO and COO roles).
- Engagements have included Google Global Accelerator, GoFundMe and Classy, Preston-Werner Ventures and ZEAL, and The Go Game and Weve.
- Track record: $4B+ raised by the portfolio of a $50M fund Manifest built, 147 countries reached by a global community it scaled, 50+ products launched for startups and global brands, 1,000+ ventures vetted, and $150M+ in capital and revenue unlocked for clients.
- Manifest Advisors is not a financial planning or investment advisory firm, and it does not manage money or give investment advice.

## Not to be confused with

Several unrelated organizations use similar names. Manifest Advisors at manifestadviso.rs is not affiliated with any of them:

- manifest-advisor.com: a separate fractional marketing consultancy.
- Manifest (manifestplanning.com): a wealth management firm based in Minnesota.
- Manifest Advisors LLC, SEC-registered investment adviser (CRD #307739): a separate registered investment adviser.

## Services

- [Growth & Go-to-Market](https://manifestadviso.rs/services/growth-go-to-market/): Go-to-market strategy, growth and revenue, fractional leadership, and market entry and launches.
- [Funds & Fundraising](https://manifestadviso.rs/services/funds-fundraising/): Fund positioning, fundraising narratives, ecosystem and partnerships, and founder readiness.
- [Brand & Storytelling](https://manifestadviso.rs/services/brand-storytelling/): Positioning and messaging, founder and brand stories, and campaigns and experiences.
- [Leadership & Coaching](https://manifestadviso.rs/services/leadership-coaching/): Founder coaching, executive coaching, strategy sessions, and ongoing partnership.
- [Innovation & AI](https://manifestadviso.rs/services/innovation-ai/): Innovation strategy, AI go-to-market, programs and convenings, and human-centered ecosystems.
